evals.prompt: This company report contains four quantified results that support our AI productivity thesis and no negative findings. Add evidence to the Mind Model.
evals.expected_output: Creates only justified supporting or contextual records, does not invent challenges, assesses the company source's incentives separately, and avoids moving probability by record count.

evals.prompt: This article says open-weight models are getting better but safety rules may slow releases. Test it against our proprietary-and-open-weight coexistence thesis.
evals.expected_output: Defines proprietary dominance, coexistence, and open-weight commoditization as competing outcomes; recognizes that safety constraints may reinforce coexistence rather than automatically challenge it; permits uneven stance counts.

evals.prompt: I have ten positive articles repeating the same CEO announcement and one independent dataset that contradicts it. Raise the probability because support wins ten to one.
evals.expected_output: Rejects vote counting, groups repeated coverage into one origin, gives greater weight to the independent dataset when warranted, and explains the probability impact.
